Refactor production workflow for tag-based deployment

- Switch production workflow trigger from branch to tag
- Remove ensure-main job and related conditional logic
- Update Docker registry to use GHCR and UHub
- Add dynamic image tagging and multi-registry push with retry
- Replace Ansible deploy with GitOps deploy via ArgoCD
- Remove unused project_name from trigger-branch workflow
- Add new trigger-tag workflow for tag pushes
